title: NFR-005: routing and discount decisions also carry reason plus evidence
risk: Only qualification is explained, while routing and pricing decisions remain opaque, so nobody can tell why a discount was granted or why a case went to a particular agent.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.

decisions.input: customer asks about a delayed parcel and stock availability

steps.expected: The routing record names the selected agent and skill plus the matched signals, with a reason and evidence references.

steps.action: Trigger a floor-policy decision on a discounted quote
steps.expected: The record stores the computed floor, the offered price, the policy inputs used and the verdict.

steps.action: Read both decision records and their audit rows
steps.expected: Both carry non-empty reason and evidence fields and agree with the audit row on the verdict.

assertions: Routing decisions record why the chosen agent and skill were selected, not only which ones.
Floor-policy decisions record the floor value and the policy inputs, so the verdict can be re-derived.
Both decide records agree with their audit rows.
Evidence references resolve, and no decision cites an absent record.
forbidden: Recording the verdict without the reasoning.
Storing only a code such as DENY without the inputs used.
Diverging reason text between the decision record and the audit row.
evidence: Both decision records with reason and evidence fields.
Audit rows for the same runs.
Floor computation trace for the discounted quote.
cleanup: Delete gov- decision rows after export.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
